26. As a sequel to the aforesaid discussions, the Corporate Debtor, 
Sri Krishna Stockist & Trader s Private Limited, is ordered to be 
liquidated under Section 33(1) of the Code with the following 
directions:  
(i) The Moratorium under Section 14 of the Code shall cease to have 
effect from the date of this order and a fresh moratorium under 
Section 33(1)(b)(iv) of the Code shall commence.  
(ii) Mr. Mannava Divakara Sarma, having IBBI Registration No. 
IBBI/IPA-001/IP-P-01192/2018-19/11917, is hereby appointed as 
the Liquidator of the Corporate Debtor for the liquidation process in 
accordance with Section 34 and other provisions of the Code, the 
Liquidation Regulations, and other applicable laws , as amended 
from time to time. 
(iii) The Liquidator shall make a public announcement stating that the 
Corporate Debtor is in liquidation, in terms of Section 33(1)(b)(ii) of 
the Code. 
(iv) The Liquidator shall exercise all the powers and perform all the 
duties as envisaged under the Code and the Liquidation 
Regulations, as amended from time to time. 
(v) No suit or other legal proceeding shall be commenced, or if pending 
at the date of the liquidation order, shall be proceeded with by the
